name: Godot Engine
description: Godot Engine is a free, open-source, cross-platform game engine developed under the Stichting Godot (Dutch non-profit). It supports 2D and 3D game development with its own GDScript language, visual scripting, and C bindings providing a complete, MIT-licensed alternative to proprietary game engines.

owner.name: Stichting Godot
owner.description: Dutch non-profit foundation (KVK 87351919) governing the Godot Engine open-source game engine project.
